title: Add project file map section to CLAUDE.md

cited_gaps.addressing_note: Repeated tool-call loops when searching for known files. A project file map would eliminate search guessing.

why.prose_summary: The tool-call-loop gap has been observed repeatedly. A project file map in CLAUDE.md would let the assistant skip exploratory searches.

what.short_description: Add a concise project file map section to CLAUDE.md listing key file paths.

how: Add a structured section to CLAUDE.md that maps common task types to their relevant file paths.
prediction: Sessions involving file location should see fewer redundant search turns.

authoring_addendum.purpose: Add a project file map section that lists key directories and files by function, enabling the assistant to locate targets without exploratory searches.
authoring_addendum.activation_conditions: The map is passive content read at session start. No activation trigger needed.
behavior_constraints: Must not exceed 40 lines to avoid context bloat.
Must list only stable paths that are unlikely to change frequently.
Must use a flat list format, not nested trees.
examples:
## Project file map
- API client: src/api_client.py
- Config parser: lib/config_parser.py
- Tests: tests/
authoring_addendum.style_hints: Match the existing CLAUDE.md tone: terse, imperative, no decorative formatting.
